speaker: george_bryan
text: Before they let the yard out. A word, Will, and I will not dress it.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Philip Howard, that was Earl of Arundel, is dead. In the Tower. On Sunday. Ten years a prisoner, by the common count, and they never brought him out to die.

speaker: john_heminges
text: I had it at noon, from a man who had it from the parish. I did not carry it to the door in the middle of a play. George has the cleaner way with a bad fact.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Since Monday, then. The word has been going round, and it reached this yard last.

speaker: george_bryan
text: It reached me as a death. I will not tell you what kind of man he was. I was not asked to improve it, and I will not.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Do not improve it. I have uses for other men's deaths. I do not want this one put ready for my hand.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Nothing was said that I will repeat as doctrine. A man is dead. The Tower kept him. That is the size of what I was given.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Ten years, and then a Sunday. I will say that once in this yard, and I will not say it again here.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Once is enough. I will think of it when the house is quiet. Not with the paint still on, and not for the company's benefit.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The yard is going out. Let it go. We are not a parish, and we are not a court of it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: We are not. Thank you, George. You were right to leave it whole.
